rules.title: SELECT *
rules.description: SELECT * in views, procedures, or application-facing queries — fragile to schema change, fetches unneeded columns.

rules.title: UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE
rules.description: UPDATE or DELETE affecting the whole table — almost always a mistake in a migration or procedure.

rules.title: Multi-statement write without transaction
rules.description: Multiple dependent INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statements without an explicit transaction — partial application on failure.

rules.title: Dynamic SQL via concatenation
rules.description: EXEC/sp_executesql on strings concatenated with parameters — injection. Use sp_executesql with parameters.

rules.title: Function on filtered column
rules.description: Function applied to an indexed column in WHERE/JOIN (e.g. CONVERT(date, col) = ...) — defeats the index, forces scans.
